s4_8_placement_reasoning: The reader (S4-8) was folded into the existing GET /api/icc/activity endpoint rather than built as a new surface. Reasoning, as the dispatch asked to have recorded: (1) hauska-mcp-server is out of scope for this dispatch (substrate's repo) and has no reader tool of its own today, so a plan-review-side reader cannot be a thin proxy over a real source-of-truth read path -- it can only report on what plan-review itself can see, which is exactly what the activity endpoint already does; (2) the OPS-17 seam table's 'ICC paid across Smart Site AND Plan Review -- one ledger' framing argues against fragmenting an already-two-surface picture with a third; (3) plan-review already hosts this exact audit-facing precedent at /api/icc/activity, so this is a sibling of an existing pattern rather than a new one. No persisted reconciliation-run log was built (CP1 had proposed one): reconciliation is a read-only comparison, not a state mutation, so it does not fall under ENFORCEMENT's durable-record requirement, and computing it fresh on each read avoids a second, unnecessary durable store for a fully-derivable value.
